cost.note: One temporary L4 builder; 45-minute Google-enforced deletion, hashed dependency lock, exact Qwen checkpoint and a single G1 development case. VM estimate uses US$1.20/hour, above the published US-central G2 rate, as a regional price and usage buffer for us-east4. Includes 25 GiB network, storage contingency, and one month of image storage at the full 100 GiB provisioned-disk ceiling. The image is retained for reuse; its continuing storage is about US$5/month at this ceiling.
